_note: Made-up sample ads for the 'Try a sample ad' buttons. Companies, sites and phone numbers are invented. 'expected' is what the checker should show.

samples.text:
Library Assistant - Northbrook Public Libraries (Harrogate)
Part-time, 22.5 hours a week including alternate Saturdays. £12.85 per hour.
You'll help visitors find books and use the public computers, run the weekly toddler rhyme time and keep the shelves in order. No library experience needed; we value friendliness and patience.
How to apply: complete the form on northbrook-libraries.org.uk/jobs. Shortlisted applicants are invited to a 30-minute interview at Harrogate Central Library.
Closing date: 5 December. Posted 4 days ago.

expected.notes: No flags, no ghost notes; must not use the word 'safe'.
